name: BL-156 criteria: the followed Four Sectors group at Monday's open (delay 0) against as followed (delay 1, Friday close)
rule: Committed before the test runs. Never edited after results are seen: a change is a new file that names this one as superseded, with the reason.
reason: Owner, 2026-10-24: switch the followed strategy to Monday-open fills only if a pre-registered test says so (BL-156 Phase 0). One full-period run had already been seen (see seen_before_writing), so the decision rests on rolling windows that were not.
base_run: 569508772cca42a8b5255203326fc1db (saved run 'Run 258': the followed config fbb7ab054238 with split_fridays on, every 4 weeks, signal_delay 1, fri_close, turnover_rank universe, curated tags, itemised costs, pre-tax). Its params equal the four followed sleeves' (search_spaces/bl142_followed.json) except split_fridays and fields Broad does not read.

B.label: Delay 0, Friday close
B.role: reference only: separates the delay effect from the fill effect; reported, never judged

windows.how: momentum_backtesting.sweep.rolling_windows over arm A's full-period weekly index (data through 2026-10-23), years 3.0, step_weeks 13. Every arm is a fresh run from each window's start to its end (sweep.rerun_windows), so each starts from the same empty portfolio. Scored with sweep.compare_rolling, baseline A.
windows.data_cutoff: 2026-10-23 (the data_version and code commit are recorded with the result)

all_must_hold.test: C has a higher CAGR AND a higher Sharpe than A in more than half of the windows (compare_rolling 'wins most')
median over windows of CAGR(C) - CAGR(A) >= +1.0 point
all_must_hold.why: the 1-point materiality BL-010 uses for fill effects; less is not worth a new routine

all_must_hold.test: median over windows of maxDD(C) - maxDD(A) >= -3.0 points (C at most 3 points deeper)
the deepest window max drawdown of C is at most 5.0 points deeper than the deepest of A
full period with tax on (slab 30%): CAGR(C) >= CAGR(A)

pass_rule.if_all_hold: pass: Phase 2 switches the followed strategy to arm C and realigns every Kite lot at once (owner, 2026-10-24)
pass_rule.otherwise: kill: the followed strategy stays on arm A. No second set of thresholds is tried on these results.

drawdown_note: A Monday-open run values the account at Monday opens, a different sampling from a Friday-close run (BL-036 Phase 2: -4.9 against -0.7 points for the engine and the replay on one config). The drawdown rules accept that sampling as it is, since it is how the switched account would be measured.

other: BL-036 Phase 2: on the delay-0, extended-tags variant of this config the Monday fill cost 0.83 CAGR points (replay 0.69)

will_not_run: re-tuning cadence, lookbacks, categories or picks at delay 0
mon_10am fills, a delay of 2 or more, Stock or Custom Index
